description: Add mentions/tags to a post. Instagram: photo tags (usernames) and collaborators (max 3). LinkedIn: mentions as { name, url } pairs — the caption must contain '@<name>' for each one. Applied when the post is published.

collaborators.description: Instagram: usernames to invite as collaborators (max 3)

name.description: Display name exactly as it should appear after the @ in the caption

url.description: LinkedIn profile or company page URL

platform.description: Which platform the mentions are for

usernames.description: Instagram: usernames to photo-tag (with or without @)

name: set_mentions
title: Set Mentions
